requirements.text: Personalised timetable management allowing customization of views (daily, weekly), color-coding modules, hiding canceled classes, and adding personal study blocks.
Automated grade notifications sent via email and in-app for new grades posted in enrolled modules, with a focus on timeliness and system performance.

Module feedback system combining structured questions focusing on key areas like content quality and delivery, and open-ended feedback options, ensuring anonymity and appropriate access to the feedback.
Ensure that the enhancements do not introduce unnecessary complexity or maintenance overhead.
